set.body:
Defect: D-reuse. 'Generalize nfrd/intake.scala out of private[bench]' is the WRONG VERB and costs more than it saves. NfrdBaseballVerifier.verify (:573-720) is participant-keyed end to end -- transcript/TextGrid manifest pairing, P\d{3}_baseball regexes, a SplitSpec partition, FieldLineage, a 17-field receipt -- and it deliberately retains NO bytes (:507-512), the opposite of what a verified-snapshot carrier needs.

Do: Extract ONLY four primitives into corpus / corpus-intake: RelativeArtifactPath (:97-120, path safety), the Reader shape (:595; `list` is new), ArtifactReceipt (:497-505, label+bytes+checksum with the path hidden from toString), and the RootIssue / ReadOperation refusal taxonomy (:141-155). Leave NfrdBaseballVerifier where it is and specialized. Shared artifact verification and retained-byte snapshots are related but DISTINCT contracts.

Tests: Each primitive keeps its existing behaviour under its new home.

Exit: Four primitives live in corpus/corpus-intake; the NFRD court is untouched.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S0, third bullet
set.title: intake: extract four reusable primitives out of the NFRD intake court
